description: The HP-28 RTO serves the Sarkaghat subdivision within the Mandi district of Himachal Pradesh. It functions as a Registration and Licensing Authority (RLA) overseen by the Sub Divisional Magistrate (SDM), handling vehicle registration and driver licensing services for the local region.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Sarkaghat, District Mandi, Himachal Pradesh
